description: FIND-009 ('unconditional touch last-pass let a no-op look healthy') is resolved for capafy and reddit (both have HC_OUTPUT wired to a real artifact -> the (d) output-staleness branch in healthcheck-lib.sh auto-escalates to self-fix, and both loops' healthcheck plists are present under ~/Library/LaunchAgents with StartInterval=300, i.e. actually scheduled). It is NOT resolved for life-manager-loop. life-manager-loop-healthcheck.sh deliberately leaves HC_OUTPUT unset (documented rationale: revenue events are rare), so the automated 5-min healthcheck for LM only ever checks liveness/stuck-menu/26h-heartbeat-staleness -- and the heartbeat is touched unconditionally by the STARTUP cron prompt regardless of whether STEP2 ACT did anything real. The stated compensating control, verify-loops.sh, is a MANUAL script: grep across /Users/anicca/Library/LaunchAgents and /Users/anicca/.openclaw for 'verify-loops' returns zero matches -- it is not wired into any launchd plist or cron job. So an LM loop that runs daily, always reports 'no-op', and always touches its heartbeat would show 'ALIVE+fresh' forever in the automated healthcheck and NEVER trigger a self-fix escalation; the only way anyone would notice is if a human manually runs verify-loops.sh, which reintroduces exactly the human-babysitting dependency the claim says does not exist.

evidence.snippet: NOTE: LM's real success = a new paid Stripe subscriber... so HC_OUTPUT is intentionally unset (liveness + stuck-detection only). Revenue truth is verified by verify-loops.sh.
